title: ever MARIS|Shimmery Lantern Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This lantern sleeve formal wedding guest dress blends comfort with glamour. The soft glitter fabric catches the light beautifully, while the cinched waist flatters your curves. Its flowy A-line skirt moves gracefully, and the lantern sleeves add a touch of drama. Perfect for weddings, cocktails, or evening celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises Shimmery.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
